items.question: Does LaToya Sanders coach the Atlanta Dream?
items.answer: Yes. The Atlanta Dream hired LaToya Sanders as an assistant coach on January 6, 2025, and she is on the Dream's 2026 coaching staff. She came from the Washington Mystics, where she was most recently associate head coach.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did LaToya Sanders play for?
items.answer: The Phoenix Mercury drafted LaToya Sanders 13th overall in 2008. She played for Phoenix (2008), Minnesota (2009), Los Angeles (2011) and the Washington Mystics, for whom she played four seasons between 2015 and 2019 and won the 2019 WNBA title. She averaged 5.7 points and 4.5 rebounds in 155 regular-season games.

items.question: Where did LaToya Sanders play college basketball?
items.answer: LaToya Sanders played at North Carolina from 2004 to 2008 and was the 2008 ACC Defensive Player of the Year.
